svg.title: B7–B12 CUDA training: validated paths by training bucket
svg.desc: L384 recomputes B7 in two CTA roles. L768 computes B7 once and passes BF16 derivatives through a 12 MiB global ring intended for L2. Both finish parameter reductions in the same CUDA launch and retain fused forward saves.
svg.text: Bidirectional TriMul · B7–B12 · ONE CUDA launch
H100 · BF16 · dropout 25% · C128 · left/right H256 each · Anthropic v5 training extension
Forward remains fused: input LN + projection/gate; saved values remain unchanged
Saved x_n, mean, inverse std, gate/projection preactivations; original x retained. B1–B6 feed this stage.
L384 · B7 recomputation + overlapped dx store
264 CTAs × 256 threads · two CTAs/SM · 112 KiB dynamic shared/CTA · zero stack/spills
